about_the_game:
Summer isn't over! Join Azura, Kincha and the rest on a trip to a tropical paradise. Boys in Hawaii! adds 25+ stages with summer flair.

And of course, some of them have made it into a really big vacation...

Meet Piña!

Piña has invited you to his beachside spot!! This wolf has been trying to get the boys out for a while now.

Piña has a new special weapon, Jacob's Ladder. This electric ability arcs downwards, zapping sweets as it goes. In water, it's even more effective...!

New story-driven content!

Hear what your favourite characters have to say. Boys in Hawaii! introduces cutscenes to Kemopop! for the first time, and they've been added to the base game, too!! Play Kemopop! from the beginning for a new, engaging experience you never had before.

Is it someone's birthday? The Calendar will know. Play on a character's birthday for a little surprise...!

It's time to get wet!

Boys in Hawaii! introduces new water-based gamemodes, with three different levels of intensity. Make matches to keep the water level down!!

Special guests, on vacation!

Boys in Hawaii! features more collaborations with new and returning guest artists!!!

In collaboration with Macop, three new stages and one new character enters the summer expansion. What would you like? Sausage? Ramen? Curry? ❤️

Other collaborations in this expansion include:

  • Toiro / といろ: No.4 makes his debut! He was born to be a servant, and wants nothing more than to please you.

  • LKIWS: Debuts Freddie, a surfing instructor with a little side job~!

  • Sakuroke / サクロケ: Duke returns with a new summer-themed stage~!!

  • HIKKU: Baro is back on the beach!

  • Bread/blackbbang1: Debuts Lumi, a fluffy shark-dragon!!

And the rest!

Boys in Hawaii! extends the game soundtrack with five new tropical beats. New sweet varieties have been added, and there's some brand new artwork to unlock~! With 25+ new stages, this is a must for cute boy enjoyers!!

content_descriptors.notes: Boys of Hawaii! brings more of the same to Kemopop!. Expect lots of hyper, and lots of boys.
